O.content: The subtitle reads "Selected high-referral centers shown in dashboard summary."
Five labeled points are visible: Center A, Center B, Center C, Center D, and Center E.

B.text: If the chart is explicitly limited to selected high-referral centers, then its pattern may be affected by selection and does not by itself characterize all centers in the network; such evidence can be retained as contextual information pending broader comparison.
B.conditions: Applies if no additional network-wide sampling, comparison group, or outcome evidence is supplied.

O.content: The title reads "Top Screening Centers: Outreach Hours vs Referral Count," and the subtitle reads "Selected high-referral centers shown in dashboard summary."

The horizontal axis is labeled "Monthly outreach hours" and its printed ticks increase from 30 at the left to 70 at the right; the vertical axis is labeled "Referral count" and its printed ticks increase from 60 near the bottom to 160 near the top.

Center A is the leftmost and lowest labeled point; Center B is to its right and higher; Center C is further right and higher; Center D is further right and higher; Center E is the rightmost and highest labeled point.

B.text: If the horizontal axis encodes monthly outreach hours increasing left-to-right and the vertical axis encodes referral count increasing upward, then the labeled center points can be compared as an observed association. A consistent higher-hours/higher-referrals pattern among the displayed selected centers is suitable for broader network review, but this cross-sectional selected-center chart alone does not establish causality, network-wide representativeness, or grounds for immediate network-level advancement.
B.conditions: Applies only to the displayed highlighted/selected high-referral screening centers and assumes the axis titles describe the plotted coordinates.
